PushEditor.Title: Pushed Roll Consequences
PushEditor.Hint: Edit consequences for each skill and state of insanity.
PushEditor.Instructions: Select an individual pushable skill. Changes are saved only when you press Save and apply to the current language.
PushEditor.ConfirmReset: Reset all consequences for this skill to their defaults? Save to keep the change.
PushEditor.ConfirmClose: Discard unsaved changes and close the editor?
PushEditor.FieldsRequired: Complete every text field of each consequence.
PushEditor.EnrichmentError: The consequence text preview could not be updated.

InterceptSystemRolls.Name: Intercept CoC7 System Rolls
InterceptSystemRolls.Hint: Routes all CoC7 skill, characteristic, Luck, Sanity, combined, opposed, and weapon checks into NRE prompts. Disable to fall back to standard CoC7 roll dialogs and chat cards.

ResultDisplayMode.Name: Roll Result Display Mode
ResultDisplayMode.Hint: Determines whether prompts and chat cards show numeric values, success levels, or both.

SuccessLevelFormat.Name: Success Level Format
SuccessLevelFormat.Hint: Displays success levels either as full text or compact symbols (* to *** / - to ---).

SanityEvaluationHints.Name: Sanity Evaluation Hints
SanityEvaluationHints.Hint: Atmospheric lines (one per line) shown to players while the Keeper evaluates the consequences of a Sanity check.
SanityEvaluationHints.Default:
Your mind struggles to comprehend what you have just witnessed...
A cold chill runs down your spine as the implications sink in...
The images burn into your memory while the fog slowly clears...
An eerie silence settles over your thoughts as reality shifts...
Your heart pounds—in a moment you will know if your sanity holds...

CombatResolvedLayout.Name: Resolved Combat Prompt Layout
CombatResolvedLayout.Hint: Chooses whether resolved combat prompts display an atmospheric scene summary or a side-by-side duel comparison.

AutomaticRangedDamage.Name: Automatically Roll Ranged Damage
AutomaticRangedDamage.Hint: Roll damage immediately after your ranged hits. The Keeper's world policy can override this preference.

RangedDamageRollPolicy.Name: Ranged Damage Roll Policy
RangedDamageRollPolicy.Hint: Choose whether each client decides how to roll ranged damage or enforce one mode for everyone.
